children: ByteDance and ZTE's jointly developed next-generation Doubao phone, the Nubia NaviX Ultra, will use ChangXin Technology's LPDDR5X memory with a top speed of 10,667Mbps. According to ChainCatcher, the company said this is the first mass-produced domestic 10,667Mbps high-speed LPDDR5X memory chip to be applied in a commercial device.
The Nubia Doubao phone has already completed network filing and is scheduled for mass production and launch in September.

title: Nubia NaviX Ultra to Use ChangXin's 10,667Mbps LPDDR5X Memory
